title: Virtual On: Cyber Troopers Net Link Edition
overview:
Climb into one of eight giant combat robots called Virtuaroids and battle one-on-one across open 3D arenas. Dash to dodge incoming fire and strike back with three weapons per robot - one on each trigger and a third when both are pressed together - mixing long-range shots with close-range attacks.

Fight through a series of simulated battles before taking the war to the moon and facing the final boss. Go head to head with a friend on a split screen, or, in this Net Link Edition, connect with the Sega Saturn Net Link modem to battle opponents online.

- Eight Virtuaroids to choose from
- Net Link playable
- Compatible with the Saturn Twin-Stick
